claim: A bank loader standing in for tape must retain each block's name, flag, checksum, order and actual transfer length, and be tested against the original tape's continuation.

evidence.text: Multiload front end: the TZX has 190,814 bytes of standard header/data blocks (24 packed 8K pages); retain block names, flags, checksums, order and actual transfer lengths; stage 2 needs original-tape versus bank-loader continuation tests.
evidence.quote: names, flags, checksums, order and actual transfer lengths; startup must reproduce BASIC setup.
